narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Ten folds make ten vee, one vee for each fold.
<bookmark mark='add'/>Ten vee is vee added ten times, like stacking ten single sheets.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Folding doubles the layers each time, so that bubble is wrong.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Repeated adding is a multiply. Repeated multiplying is a power.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Find three plus three plus three plus three, and three times three times three times three.
